title: Automating Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) Formulation Generation from Natural Language
description:
arXiv:2609.10629v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) is a central formulation for combinatorial optimization and has gained increasing attention due to its compatibility with quantum, hybrid quantum-classical, and quantum-inspired solvers.
